test_case.name: Container Crash (Unhandled Runtime Panic / SIGSEGV)
test_case.scenario_description: An invoice batch worker container ('invoice-worker') in pod 'invoice-generator-5f7b8d9c1-q4n8w' (namespace 'billing') crashes mid-execution due to an unhandled nil pointer dereference (SIGSEGV) when processing an invoice record with a null tax jurisdiction object. The container terminates immediately with exit code 2.
test_case.injected_fault: Null tax_jurisdiction struct dereferenced in CalculateRegionalTax(), triggering Go runtime SIGSEGV panic and container exit code 2.
test_case.ground_truth_rca: Container 'invoice-worker' in pod 'invoice-generator-5f7b8d9c1-q4n8w' crashed with exit code 2 due to an unhandled Go runtime nil pointer dereference panic (SIGSEGV) in billing/tax.CalculateRegionalTax() at invoice_processor.go:142.

suggested_remediation: Fetch previous terminated container logs: `kubectl logs <pod-name> --previous` or `kubectl logs <pod-name> -c <container> -p`.
Describe the pod to review the termination state, last exit code, and message: `kubectl describe pod <pod-name>`.
Verify container entrypoint and command syntax in deployment specification.
Run an interactive debug shell in a clone container: `kubectl debug <pod-name> -it --image=busybox`.
